label: CJEU C-673/17 — Planet49 (cookie consent)
body: 1. Consent under Art. 5(3) ePrivacy + Art. 4(11)/6(1)(a) GDPR is not validly constituted if cookie storage/access is permitted by way of a pre-checked checkbox which the user must deselect to refuse.
2. The consent requirement applies regardless of whether the information stored or accessed is personal data — Art. 5(3) protects the user's private sphere either way.
3. The information that must be provided to the user under Art. 5(3) includes the duration of the operation of cookies and whether third parties may have access to them.

Why it matters: Foundational case for cookie banners. Pre-ticked = invalid; active behaviour required; cookie disclosures must cover duration + recipients. Pre-2021 CJEU authority — assimilated/retained EU case law in the UK (departable by UK appellate courts).
